		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = sheep_farms } pp_cplan_goods_here_farm_constructions = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sheep_farms building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = sheep_farms }
		}
	}
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_best
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_pick
}

# Location scope: a Victualling Yard level here: the next level of a standing Yard while it pays back within the
# food rule's line (pp_cplan_yard_payback), a first level where victuals cost at least their default price here.
pp_cplan_try_yard_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = victualling_yard } pp_cplan_goods_here_victuals_trade_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:victualling_yard building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		building_type:victualling_yard = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		pp_cplan_btype_data = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						pp_cplan_bt_levels > 0.5
						pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= pp_cplan_yard_payback
					}
					AND = {
						pp_cplan_bt_levels < 0.5
						pp_cplan_victuals_price_ratio >= 1
					}
				}
			}
			pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = victualling_yard }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope, never run (pp_cplan_run calls it under always = no): declares the flags the window passes, so the
# script check logs no 'used but never set' line for them.
pp_cplan_declare_flags = {
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:access_line }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:business }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:business_line }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:down }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:food }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:improve }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:improve_line }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:logistics }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:profiles }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:reserve }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:reserve_big }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:up }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w1 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w10 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w2 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w3 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w4 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w5 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w6 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w7 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w8 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_flag value = flag:w9 }
}

# Location scope: one level of the improvement that adds the most capacity per gold here (pp_cplan_imp_<key>),
# among those that can be built; a standing older tier is replaced once its successor is researched.
pp_cplan_try_improve_here = {
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = 0.001 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = bund } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:bund building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_bund > var:pp_cplan_best }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = pp_cplan_imp_bund }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 101 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = field_drainage } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:field_drainage building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_field_drainage > var:pp_cplan_best }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = pp_cplan_imp_field_drainage }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 102 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = field_management } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:field_management building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_field_management > var:pp_cplan_best }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = pp_cplan_imp_field_management }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 103 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = field_management_convertible } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:field_management_convertible building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_field_management_convertible > var:pp_cplan_best }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = pp_cplan_imp_field_management_convertible }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 104 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = field_management_improved } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:field_management_improved building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_field_management_improved > var:pp_cplan_best }

# Country scope: marks every business type the country can build now (pp_cplan_bz_<type>; the country's part of the
# can-build check, once a pass instead of once per location), and clears the marks after the pass.

# Location scope (a business site of scope:pp_cplan_country): the business with the best yearly return here that
# reaches the owner's line (pp_cplan_business_min_roi = 100 / years), as pp_cplan_bz_pick (a building type) and
# pp_cplan_bz_roi (its return, %); neither where none does. A candidate: the country can build it, so can this
# location (max level, allow, potential), a level finds its workers here (pp_cplan_staff), the market holds its
# construction goods, no level of it here is closed (the player or the game's Close and Open automation found
# it does not pay), and a profile here leaves its good and building category to the plan.
pp_cplan_business_pick = {
	pp_cplan_business_harvest = yes
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_free_peasants value = pp_cplan_free_peasants_here }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_bz_pick
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_bz_roi value = scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_business_min_roi }
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_bz_ablaq_palace }
			pp_cplan_staff = { type = burghers size = 0.25 }
			can_build_building = building_type:ablaq_palace
			NOT = { pp_lprof_has_good = { g = silk } }
			NOT = { pp_lprof_has_category = { c = government_category } }
			pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes
			NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:ablaq_palace building_level > 0 is_opened = no } }
		}
		building_type:ablaq_palace = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.41 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_guild_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_r value = pp_cplan_bz_roi_ablaq_palace }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_r > var:pp_cplan_bz_roi }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_bz_roi value = scope:pp_cplan_r }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_bz_pick value = building_type:ablaq_palace }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_bz_alum_quarry }
			pp_cplan_staff = { type = laborers size = 0.8 }
			can_build_building = building_type:alum_quarry
			NOT = { pp_lprof_has_good = { g = alum } }
			pp_cplan_goods_here_mercury_patio_construction = yes
			NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:alum_quarry building_level > 0 is_opened = no } }
		}
		building_type:alum_quarry = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.14 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_mercury_patio_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_r value = pp_cplan_bz_roi_alum_quarry }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_r > var:pp_cplan_bz_roi }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_bz_roi value = scope:pp_cplan_r }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_bz_pick value = building_type:alum_quarry }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_bz_alum_works }
			pp_cplan_staff = { type = laborers size = 0.8 }

			NOT = { pp_lprof_has_good = { g = alum } }

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.14 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
